    Class TpPuzzle

    The custom <tp-puzzle> element provides an image puzzle with movable and rotatable pieces.

    Example

    <tp-puzzle src="/docs/components/puzzle/examples/landscape.svg" pieces="12" alt="Mountain lake at sunrise"></tp-puzzle>

    Tagname

    tp-puzzle

    Attr

    src = "" - Image URL (SVG, PNG, WebP or JPEG); overrides an initial img child. Changing it starts a new game.

    Attr

    pieces = 16 - Exact number of pieces, from 1 to 144. A factor grid is chosen to approximate the image aspect ratio.

    Attr

    shape = "puzzle" - Square, interlocking, equilateral triangle or regular hexagon pieces.

    Attr

    alt = "" - Description of the image; falls back to the initial img alternative text.

    Attr

    exact-orientation = false - Starts every piece upright instead of randomly rotated; changing it restarts the game. tp-puzzle-load Emitted when the image is loaded and the pieces are ready.

    Eventdetail

    tp-puzzle-load { pieces: number; rows: number; columns: number } tp-puzzle-change Emitted after a placement, rotation, undo, redo or shuffle; placements are independent copies.

    Eventdetail

    tp-puzzle-change { placements: PuzzlePlacement[]; solved: boolean } tp-puzzle-complete Emitted when a move first completes the current arrangement.

    Eventdetail

    tp-puzzle-complete { placements: PuzzlePlacement[]; solved: boolean } tp-puzzle-error Emitted when the configuration or image cannot be loaded.

    Eventdetail

    tp-puzzle-error { message: string }

    Keyboard

    Arrow keys Move the selected piece; Shift increases the step.

    Keyboard

    R / Shift+R Rotate the selected piece by ±90° for square/puzzle or ±60° for triangle/hexagon.

    Keyboard

    ContextMenu / Shift+F10 Open the selected piece rotation menu.

    Keyboard

    Escape Cancel a drag or close the rotation menu.

    Keyboard

    Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z Undo / redo; Command is also supported.

    Accessibility

    Pieces are labelled focusable SVG buttons. Keyboard movement and rotation are alternatives to dragging; progress is announced politely.

    Accessibilityresponsibility

    Describe the source image with alt and offer an alternative activity when a visual spatial puzzle is not usable.

    See

    tp-tangram - Assemble a silhouette from seven geometric pieces.
